about_the_game:
Line it up. Launch the shot. Land the impossible.

Hundreds of handcrafted levels, devious challenges, and ridiculous trick shots. Miss, adjust, try again. And again. And again. Until that perfect shot transforms frustration into pure glory.

Game of Skill takes the timeless “throw a thing into another thing” and turns it into a cycle of persistence and payoff. No chasing stray balls, just you, the cup, and the shot you know you can make.

It starts simple, but the challenge ramps up quickly. You’ll need more than just aim, you’ll need precision, timing, creative problem-solving, and maybe even a little luck. It may take a few tries… or a few hundred. That’s all part of the fun.

The journey to the cup is full of twists and turns:

  • Bounce across platforms that move, crumble, and seek to ruin your perfect plan

  • Activate key blocks and gates to unlock the goal

  • Dodge instant-death spikes waiting to punish one wrong angle

  • Navigate intense wind currents trying to blow you off course

  • Teleport through magical portals that twist your sense of direction

  • Survive bizarre gravity fields that warp your perception

…and maybe a few other surprises along the way.

Failure is part of the process, and every attempt brings you one step closer to perfection. Don’t be afraid to experiment, the path is not always obvious. Game of Skill is the ultimate test of patience, precision, and persistence.

Features:

  • Hundreds of handcrafted levels, each begging for “just one more try”

  • Evolving, unpredictable trials that challenge your expectations

  • Unlockable theme options to customize your style

  • Featuring a dynamic soundtrack from new and existing artists, including MDTM, ST@R•FL€X, and Amos Cochran, to encourage you every step of the way

  • Simple, precise controls. Great with a mouse, even better with a touchscreen

  • No ads, no in-app purchases, nothing between you and the gameplay

You can do it.

I believe in you.

Add it to your Wishlist now and prove you’ve got what it takes.

name: Game of Skill
short_description: A physics-driven skill game of persistence and payoff. Miss, adjust, and try again until you finally sink the impossible shot. Face hundreds of handcrafted levels with shifting platforms, deadly spikes, mind-bending portals, and bizarre gravity fields.
